owner_impact: The three known Virtual Lab capabilities keep their existing stable request IDs and lifecycle states, while gaining a clean owner-approved generic definition and minimal publication provenance. Historical Grok request reasoning, Professor notes, Experiment linkage and other discourse remain preserved internally but are not part of the canonical capability meaning. This ticket does not yet change what MCP returns; that is the next ticket.

next.text: #334 is the known successor. It will change the MCP read surface so fresh research-AI sessions receive the formal Lab contract and canonical capability metadata instead of raw Experiment/request discourse. #334 has not started in this owner turn.

technical_evidence: Existing capability-request UUIDs remain the stable capability identities; no second capability table or duplicate lifecycle state is introduced.
canonical_definition is seeded only from already owner-approved/repository-authoritative generic capability meaning.
publication_provenance contains only published title plus DOI/arXiv identifier.
Historical request context, draft descriptions, Professor notes and lifecycle fields are not deleted or rewritten.
Regression coverage rejects historical paper-specific reasoning from the canonical seed and rejects lifecycle/deletion changes.
